parole.testo: Borrowed from English karaoke, from Japanese カラオケ (karaoke, literally “empty orchestra”), from 空 (から, kara) + オーケストラ (ōkesutora, from English orchestra).
Borrowed from English rickshaw, from Japanese 力(りき)車(しゃ) (rikisha), clipping of 人(じん)力(りき)車(しゃ) (jinrikisha).
